author: WafflBytes
name: BRUTAL game skeleton
description: An empty BRUTAL game with the plumbing done: licence splash (logo + credits), NOTICE and third-party notices, single-file publish, crash and VC++ runtime dialogs, a fixed-step loop, TrueType text, SDL_mixer sound, --selftest, --snapshot and --smoke. A placeholder marker stands in for your game. --renderer sdl (2D SDL renderer, default) or gl (SDL3 window + OpenGL 4.1 core).

choices.description: SDL3 2D renderer: sprites, shapes, pixel art. Runs anywhere, including Remote Desktop.
SDL3 window with an OpenGL 4.1 core context (GLAD): 3D, shaders.
